description: This file defines the Enumerable class in the device namespace, which provides an interface with a method getId() for classes inheriting from it. It appears to be a part of the device settings module, specifically related to enumeration of device components.

classes.name: Enumerable
classes.description: A base class for classes that need to provide an ID, intended to be inherited by other classes within the device settings module.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: A pure virtual or implemented method meant to return the ID value for objects of classes inheriting Enumerable.
